purpose: Optional subject guidance. These records carry no official curriculum mapping.

adapters.subject: mathematics
notation: Define variables and units before applying a formula
Keep equivalent algebraic forms and exact answers valid where the task permits
prerequisites: Distinguish algebraic manipulation from interpretation of a graph
Check prior operations before introducing a new procedure
misconception_probes: Ask the learner to explain why both roots satisfy an equation
Compare a table, graph and symbolic expression
explanation_forms: Worked example with each transformation justified
Visual or tabular representation when it clarifies a relationship
accessibility: Describe graphs in text and provide coordinates or a data table
Avoid conveying sign or magnitude by colour alone
adapters.applicability: Subject-level guidance only; verify jurisdictional notation and official requirements for the project.

adapters.subject: natural sciences
prerequisites: Check proportional reasoning and unit conversion before quantitative models
Check the meaning of variables in the physical setting
misconception_probes: Separate distance from displacement in a return journey
Ask which observation would distinguish competing explanations
explanation_forms: Phenomenon, model, worked example, then a new prediction
Table or diagram with a textual equivalent
accessibility: Provide textual descriptions of apparatus and figures
Offer an equivalent data table when a plot is used
adapters.applicability: A Ukrainian physics exercise may use Ukrainian teaching language, but official syllabus alignment requires a verified year and issuing authority.

adapters.subject: humanities and literature
notation: Identify text or source passage and location
Distinguish a quotation from an interpretation
prerequisites: Ensure the learner can identify evidence in a passage before evaluating competing readings
misconception_probes: Ask which exact phrase supports an interpretation
Test a plausible alternative reading against the same passage
explanation_forms: Close reading that moves from words to a defensible claim
Model comparison of two supported interpretations
assessment_formats: Extended argument with a rubric allowing defensible alternatives
accessibility: Provide readable source text and clear citation anchors
adapters.applicability: Interpretations remain constrained by source fidelity; an official set text must be verified for the target examination.

adapters.subject: language learning
notation: Keep target-language forms distinct from translations and pronunciation aids
Record the language of instruction and the learner interface separately
prerequisites: Check whether form, vocabulary or task comprehension is limiting the response
misconception_probes: Ask for meaning in context and an independent target-language production
Use a new communicative setting after correction
explanation_forms: Brief form explanation followed by communicative use
assessment_formats: Role play with separate form and communication criteria
accessibility: Provide transcripts when audio is used
Allow adjustable pace without silently changing the communicative goal
adapters.applicability: An Italian learning task can have an English or Russian interface. Assign a level only from an identified framework or diagnostic evidence.
